verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for a ROCm documentation llms.txt at rocm.docs.amd.com/llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed at it to reach the ROCm and Instinct docs that cover the MI325X. The file itself says the docs are split across multiple projects, and the probe for markdown-rendered doc pages returned 404, so the agent-oriented layer is shallow. missing for 10: per-page markdown versions of the docs, evidence that the llms.txt covers the Instinct/MI325X-specific doc projects, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
